entities.summary: Faisal bin Abdullah Al Saud is a retired Saudi Arabian politician and businessman who served as the Saudi Arabian minister of education from 2009 to 2013 in the administration of King Abdullah, his maternal uncle and father-in-law. He is a member of the House of Saud. Faisal bin Abdullah bin Mohammed Al Saud was a performers & entertainers from Riyadh (b. 1950-05-13, Riyadh). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
